rationale.consistency: Perfectly matches existing codebase conventions and idioms, cleanly integrating variadic command modifiers.
rationale.edge_cases: Robustly handles existing local branches, path normalization, explicitly blank paths, and exclusive flag validations.
rationale.scope: Completes all specific requirements including shared target resolution and Git helpers without feature creep.
rationale.readability: Cleanly structured with clear abstractions (checkoutWorktree) and highly readable git client command setups.
rationale.robustness: Properly surfaces all git errors and safely applies worktree rules before mutation.
rationale.maintainability: Highly maintainable through excellent extraction of shared validation and command generation in pr/shared.
